data.summary:
.NET Technical Lead | C#, ASP.NET Core, Azure, API, SQL Server | Generative AI Integration 
Dot Net Technical Lead with 12+ years of experience in designing and delivering enterprise-grade solutions using C#, .NET Core, Web API, SQL Server, AWS, Azure Cloud and AI assist development with hands-on exposure in cloud- native components such as Azure Functions and Logic Apps. Strong background in architecture design, SQL optimization, and Agile-based team leadership for successful project delivery.
Career Highlights • Conducted code reviews and implemented best coding practices, ensuring code quality, maintainability, and
adherence to SOLID principles.
Lead multiple projects end-to-end — from requirement analysis to deployment — ensuring timely
delivery under Agile methodology. Implemented secure and scalable APIs using C#, ASP.NET, MVC, .NET Core, Entity Framework, and SQL Server. Involved in CI/CD pipeline setup and release management using Azure DevOps and Jenkins.
• • Proven ability to work as an individual contributor as well as lead developer — responsible for design, coding, and deployment.
Having good experience in L3 support. • Provided technical mentoring to team members to improv productivity and overall technical capability. • Collaborated with onshore clients for requirement gathering, design discussions, and sprint planning.

raw_sections.skills:
Technical Expertise Primary Skills: C#, .NET 8, ASP.NET Core, Web API, REST API, MVC, ADO.NET, SQL Server, LINQ, Entity Framework Core, .Net Stack, Design Patterns, SOLID, Agile.
Secondary Skills: Angular, Microservices, RabbitMQ, JavaScript, CSS, XUnit.
Cloud & DevOps: Microsoft Azure (Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Application Insights, Key Vault, Blob Storage, Microsoft Entra ID, Notification Hub), AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3), Docker, Jenkins, CI/CD Pipelines.
Tools: Visual Studio 2022, VS Code, SQL Server Management Studio, Postman, Fiddler, GitHub, JIRA, Azure Portal.
Domain Knowledge Banking | Insurance | Education | Travel | HealthCare | HR | Inventory
Soft Skills Leadership | Client Communication | Agile Delivery | Mentoring | Problem Solving | Analytical Thinking | Team Collaboration | Innovation
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Technical Lead | Coforge Ltd. | Nov 2025 – Present Leading enterprise-level applications in travel and Insurance domains. Client interaction on daily bases with USA/Australia client. Deployment. Implement CI/CD Pipeline. Code review.
Key Responsibilities: • Designed and developed RESTful APIs and backend modules in .NET Core. • Implemented logging, CI/CD, and Azure deployments. • Implemented secure Authentication and Authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, and JWT-based token validation within .NET APIs.
Collaborated with clients and mentored developers for solution delivery.
.Net Engineer | HCL Tech | Oct 2024 – Sep 2025 Worked on multiple projects for healthcare and banking domains such as ING Bank. Contributed to modernization, performance optimization, and API development.
Key Responsibilities: • API and Service Integration. • Enhanced APIs, improved SQL performance, and implemented secure deployments. • Provided production support and performed technical analysis for existing systems.
Senior Software Developer | JK Techno soft Ltd. | Nov 2020 – Apr 2023 Work on HR and Healthcare domains like Greenway Health in US. Attending the daily scrum meetings, Gathering the requirements from clients for particular sprint and stories, Implementation of business logic, Deploy the build, Creating the pipeline and releases for testing. Bug fixing, Generate the Pull Request and verify the code changes on production.
Key Responsibilities: • Worked on user interface using ASP.NET and JavaScript. • Designed data access layers using ADO.NET and Entity Framework. • Developed stored procedures for complex financial operations.
Senior Dot Net Developer | Quess Corp. Ltd. | Jun 2018 – Jul 2019 Lead multiple .NET projects like Vehicle Tracking System on travel domain including BEST for Mumbai.
Key Responsibilities: • Responsible for system design, coding, and deployment. • 
Analyst Programmer | Path Infotech Ltd. | May 2015 – May 2018 Worked on multiple projects for education and HR domain. Implement the business logics, Database Design, Bug Fixing, Application Maintenance, Client Interaction.
Key Responsibilities: · Requirement Analysis and Designing. · Implementation of Business Logic . Developing WCF service . L1 and L2 support.
Senior Software Engineer | Bajaj Capital Ltd. | Jul 2010 – May 2015 Lead multiple .NET projects like Wealth maker, Daily Activity Report, and 360-degree financial planning on insurance and HR domains.
Key Responsibilities: · Design UI and Reports as per requirement · Implementation of Business Logic and web services · Creating scheduler for synchronizing the records · Database Design
